select d.id,d.tid, a.COLUMN_NAME AS col, '' AS col_name, a.DATA_TYPE AS FORMAT_TYPE, (case when a.DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' then '('||a.DATA_PRECISION||','||a.DATA_SCALE||')' else to_char(a.CHAR_LENGTH) end) AS FORMAT_SIZE, c.constraint_type as PRIMARY_KEY, a.NULLABLE AS nullable, b.COMMENTS AS DESCRIBE, 1 as status, a.column_id as sort from (select TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,DATA_PRECISION,DATA_SCALE,CHAR_LENGTH,NULLABLE,column_id from user_tab_columns) a left join user_col_comments b on (a.TABLE_NAME = b.TABLE_NAME and a.COLUMN_NAME = b.COLUMN_NAME ) left join (select con.table_name,col.column_name,con.constraint_type from user_constraints con,user_cons_columns col where con.constraint_name=col.constraint_name and con.constraint_type in ('P','U','R')) c on (a.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME and a.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME) left join (select a.id,a.tid,a.col,b.name from PDA_TABLE_COLUMN a,PDA_TABLES b where a.TID=b.id) d ON (a.TABLE_NAME = d.name and a.COLUMN_NAME = d.col) where d.col is not null order by a.TABLE_NAME, a.COLUMN_ID

select d.id as tid, a.COLUMN_NAME AS col, '' AS col_name, a.DATA_TYPE AS FORMAT_TYPE, (case when a.DATA_TYPE = 'NUMBER' then '('||a.DATA_PRECISION||','||a.DATA_SCALE||')' else to_char(a.CHAR_LENGTH) end) AS FORMAT_SIZE, c.constraint_type as PRIMARY_KEY, a.NULLABLE AS nullable, b.COMMENTS AS DESCRIBE, 1 as status, a.column_id as sort from (select TABLE_NAME,COLUMN_NAME,DATA_TYPE,DATA_PRECISION,DATA_SCALE,CHAR_LENGTH,NULLABLE,column_id from user_tab_columns) a left join user_col_comments b on (a.TABLE_NAME = b.TABLE_NAME and a.COLUMN_NAME = b.COLUMN_NAME ) left join (select con.table_name,col.column_name,con.constraint_type from user_constraints con,user_cons_columns col where con.constraint_name=col.constraint_name and con.constraint_type in ('P','U','R')) c on (a.TABLE_NAME = c.TABLE_NAME and a.COLUMN_NAME = c.COLUMN_NAME) left join PDA_TABLES d on (a.TABLE_NAME = d.name) left join PDA_TABLE_COLUMN e on (d.id = e.tid and a.COLUMN_NAME = e.col) where e.col is null and d.id is not null order by a.TABLE_NAME, a.COLUMN_ID
